description: Source code implementing proxy configuration handling, including classes and functions for managing proxy rules, parsing proxy strings, and converting configurations to a value representation.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Represents the overall proxy configuration, including automatic and manual settings.

classes.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules
classes.description: Encapsulates rules for proxy selection, including different proxy lists per scheme and fallback options.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::Apply
methods.description: Applies proxy rules to a given URL, setting the result accordingly.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::ParseFromString
methods.description: Parses a proxy configuration string into proxy rules.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::MapUrlSchemeToProxyList
methods.description: Returns the proxy list for a given URL scheme, considering fallback rules.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two ProxyRules instances.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::MapUrlSchemeToProxyListNoFallback
methods.description: Returns the proxy list for a scheme without considering fallback rules.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::GetProxyListForWebSocketScheme
methods.description: Returns the preferred proxy list for WebSocket connections based on RFC 6455 recommendations.

methods.name: ProxyConfig
methods.description: Main class for managing proxy configuration, including serialization to a value object.
